top_signals.title: Statement by President von der Leyen following her visit to the Emergency Response Coordination Centre
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 31 Aug 2026 I want to start with a simple message – thank you, this is a message for all of you, at my side or in the background. Dear Commissioner, dear Director-General, to the staff from the ERCC and ECHO, thank you for being here when Europe needs you most. As you have said – and I learned a lot in this hour here - day and night, 24/7, weekends and on holidays, whenever a crisis strikes, the team is there.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
